result.summary: Found 2 visible issues: one major layout problem where the fixed bottom navigation obscures content, and one minor content typo in the search placeholder.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the page content, cutting off the lower restaurant card in the "Popular right now" section.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so cards are fully visible above the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The search placeholder text says "Restarants" instead of "Restaurants".
issues.suggestion: Correct the spelling in the placeholder copy.
